tool.name: remove_package
tool.description: Remove a package using the system package manager

when_to_use.trigger: User asks to uninstall or remove software
User wants to clean up unused packages
User asks to free disk space by removing packages

safety_rules.rule: Never remove critical system packages (systemd, glibc, kernel)
Show what will be removed including dependencies
Warn if removing package has many dependents
Suggest keeping config files unless explicitly asked to purge

tool.output_format: Returns: { "package": string, "removed": boolean, "purged": boolean, "dependencies_removed": [string], "space_freed_mb": integer, "message": string }
